_A_DRAWER_COMPONENT_DESCRIPTION_: ADrawer is a panel at the left or the right edge of the window, e.g. for the details of a table row, filters or settings. It is a modal dialog: it has all props and slots of AModal (header, footer with buttons, save, selector-close-ids…), traps the focus, closes with Escape and returns the focus to the button that opened it.
_A_DRAWER_BASIC_DESCRIPTION_: placement sets the edge. selector-close-ids returns the focus to the button that opened the panel. On a narrow window the panel takes the whole width. The panel slides in, without animation if the user prefers reduced motion.
_A_DRAWER_EXAMPLE_BODY_: The panel is a modal dialog: the page behind it is not reachable until it is closed.
_A_DRAWER_SIZES_DESCRIPTION_: The prop size of AModal sets the width: small 300px, large 600px, xl 900px, without size 400px. The widths are CSS variables.
_A_DRAWER_FORM_DESCRIPTION_: A form in the panel with the buttons Save and Cancel. With is-footer-sticky the buttons stay visible while the form scrolls. The form edits a copy of the model, so Cancel does not change the data.
